notes.title: New Update: Survival Mode, Difficulty Settings, Save System Overhaul & More!
notes.notes: [p]Hello everyone![/p][p][/p][p]We’ve just released a new update for Mythic Battlegrounds: Demonic Siege, and it brings some exciting new features and important improvements:[/p][p][/p][h3][b]🔥 Survival Mode (New Game Mode)[/b][/h3][p]A new endless mode is now available for players who have completed the main campaign at least once. Survival Mode challenges you to hold the line against increasingly difficult waves of enemies.[/p][list][*][p]Each day, enemies grow stronger.[/p][/*][*][p]No boss battles, but you gain 1 skill point after each day to upgrade your skills.[/p][/*][*][p]Spend your excess gold at the Blacksmith to permanently boost your army's health and damage.[/p][/*][*][p]Try 3 additional challenges to test your skills to the limit in the Survival Mode.[/p][/*][*][p]You can save your progress, but be warned: if you lose, your save is deleted.[/p][/*][*][p]Survival Mode becomes available after finishing Chapter 8. If you completed the game before the update and don’t see it unlocked, you’ll need to complete Chapter 8 once more using your current save.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b]💾 Save System Overhaul[/b][/h3][p]Our save system has been reworked based on community feedback. Previously, there was no way of saving your progress mid-chapter. Now, you can save and quit on any day and resume the game where you left off.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]♻ Skill Reset[/b][/h3][p]You will now be able to reset your skills once at the end of Chapter 4. This gives you a chance to reassign your skill points before you continue with the rest of the campaign.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]⚙ Difficulty Settings[/b][/h3][p]You can now choose between three difficulty levels when starting a new game:[/p][list][*][p]Easy: Lower wound rate, checkpoints on defeat, bonus gold after battles, and a skill reset option at the end of Chapter 4.[/p][/*][*][p]Medium: Moderate wound rate, no checkpoints, and a skill reset option at the end of Chapter 4.[/p][/*][*][p]Hard: Higher wound rate, no checkpoints, and no skill reset.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b]🐞 Bug Fixes & Balance Improvements[/b][/h3][p]We’ve addressed several bugs and made some balance adjustments based on your feedback to improve the overall experience.[/p][p][/p][p]Thanks to everyone who has played and shared their thoughts - your feedback makes a big difference as we continue improving the game.[/p][p][/p][p]Let us know what you think of the new features and, as always, see you on the battlefield![/p][p][/p][p]The Dochi Games Team[/p]

notes.title: Last update before the launch
notes.notes:
Language Support
The game now supports Turkish, Polish, Spanish and German (Windows version for now, MacOs and Linux will be updated in a few days)

All units had the same range (6) previously. We altered the attack range of the following units.

Hobgoblin: Range 6 --> 5
Mage: Range 6 --> 7
Archmage: Range 6 --> 7
Druid: Range 6 --> 5
Archdruid: Range 6 --> 5
Sniper:Range 6 --> 8

Balance changes:

Lich King: Increased summon cooldown
Banazar: Increased HP, damage, and splash.
The Engineer: Decreased damage.
Banshee: One fewer death dragon.
Malezar:Increased Hellfire damage.
Runemasters: Nerfed damage reduction debuff.
Mercenary Guild: Building cost increased but additional cost of hiring mercenaries dropped from 10% to 5%  - Now Lord Elysion's bonus is more valuable.

QoL improvements & Bug fixes
Added tooltip showing the unit value at companion selection
Fixed the issue with volume settings resetting in some computers
Improved skill descriptions

Note: All of these updates are for windows version. MacOs and Linux versions will have the update in a few days


Next up:

Skill reset will be added at the end of chapter 4
Difficulty modes will be added
Endless Survival mode will be added

Stay tuned!
